sources.title: Drew Brees thought about returning?
sources.description: Supposedly, Adam Schefter reported that Drew Brees flirted with the idea of helping save the Broncos’ playoff run last year when Bo Nix broke his ankle. This is a great talking point. We get to wistfully wonder, “What if?” But let’s be real, Broncos Country. There’s no way that would have ever worked. First of […]
